title: AI-powered robots are next in war tech, Ukraine’s former defense minister says
source_used: The Washington Post (headline only; article not reachable)
why_it_matters_hint: A former defense minister's claim about AI-run robots in war, not checked here.
notes: Washington Post page returned no connection (HTTP 000). The search found no other outlet with the same statement.
